MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 1781
GRANTING PHILIPPINE CITIZENSHIP TO JOSEPH WILLIAM STEVENS Y VALDEZ
WHEREAS, he was born in the Philippines on May 4, 1935 of a distinguished Filipino mother and an
American father who fought and was captured in Bataan, participate in the famous Death March and died as
prisoner of the enemy in 1945;
WHEREAS, even as a citizen of the United States, he contributed his expertise in the development of our
insurance industry in the last twenty-one (21) years;
WHEREAS, since his birth in the Philippines and up to the present time, he has also selflessly dedicated
himself to the upliftment of sports in the country particularly football and in the same spirit has involved
himself with institutions devoted to the task of preserving our environmental ecology;
WHEREAS, he and his family have decided to make the Philippines their permanent home to which they shall
forever owe and pledge allegiance and loyalty.
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the
Constitution do hereby grant Philippine citizenship to Joseph William Stevens y Valdez with all the rights,
privileges and prerogatives appurtenant thereto, provided, he takes his oath of allegiance within thirty (30)
days herefrom.
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
